To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
it is possible to design a colorless road sign classification algorithm which can achieve comparable classification results to the ones obtained using the color-based approach.
the colorless method is a robust and reliable method for the road signs classification in gray-level images.

the proposed road sign classification method is able to recognize road signs in traffic scenes without color information, and it is able to recognize the road signs from the same road sign groups as the color-based counterpart of the method, and it is also able to recognize the signs from the other road sign groups than its color-based counterpart of method.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following issues: (a) the decomposition of the road sign classification into several groups/subproblems, (b) the development of a general colorless method for each group/subproblem, (c) the combination of color-based and colorless road sign recognition systems, (d) the comparison of both recognition systems.

the development of the robust road sign classification algorithm that is not limited to the specific color conditions and that may be used in the combination with the colorless sign detection algorithm.
the development of a new method for the road-sign classification in gray-level images.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the presented method may be used for road sign classification in the traffic scene images without color information and it may be used as complementary procedure to the color-based methods.
the colorless approach is a useful and reliable alternative for the color-based approach in the case of the road sign classification problem.
the presented colorless method for road sign classification is able to achieve the same recognition results as the color-based one.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have developed a colorless method for road sign classification which is robust to the illumination conditions, and allows the same decomposition of classification problem as its color-based counterparts.
the color information may be used as one of the attributes for the recognition of road signs in traffic images but it should not be considered as an indispensable one.

the road sign classification problem is decomposed into several aprioric groups and the colorless method is applied to each of them separately.

The main takeaway from our work is that
